title: MosaicRV exclusion ledger (V-020)
description: One entry per exclusion: every disabled checker, skipped case or suite, waived field, unimplemented reference feature, timeout that stands in for a verdict, and generation step that can drop a test. Each entry records why the exclusion exists, its specification basis (or an explicit statement that there is none), what covers the behaviour instead (naming a case or checker that exists and passes, or explicitly nothing), the cases and fields affected, and the condition that would let the exclusion be removed. tools/check_exclusions.py validates this file, refuses any registry case without a recorded PASS that is not named here, and carries negative controls that must themselves be rejected.

kind_semantics.description: What each exclusion kind means, stated once so the ledger is self-describing and a kind can never be added without a definition.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the ledger.

subjects.description: The concrete things excluded: checker names, suite names, file paths, CSR/field names, model features. This is the machine-readable enumeration; a grouped entry must still list every member.

reason.description: Why the exclusion exists. An exclusion with no reason is a silent skip.

spec_clause.description: The specification clause that makes the excluded behaviour a requirement, or an explicit statement that no clause applies and why.

status.description: covered: something that exists and passes covers the behaviour. open: nothing does; this is a carried gap.

cases.description: Registry case names that cover the behaviour. Each must exist in tests/unit/registry.json and have a recorded PASS.

checks.description: Tool paths (relative to the repository root) that cover the behaviour. Each must exist and be referenced by the Makefile.

fields.description: The fields, phases or outputs of that case the exclusion concerns. May be empty when the whole case is affected.

affected_cases.description: Registry cases the exclusion touches. Every `case` must exist in tests/unit/registry.json. May be empty for an exclusion that is not tied to any registered case, in which case affected_scope names what it touches.

affected_scope.description: Files, targets, suites or models the exclusion touches, so a global exclusion still says what it concerns.

end_condition.description: What would let this exclusion be removed. An empty end condition is an exclusion with no exit.
